description: This file defines the class ImmutableAttributesBuilder, a mutable builder for ImmutableAttributes, providing a fluent API for constructing JSON-based attribute objects.

classes.name: ImmutableAttributesBuilder
classes.description: A final class implementing AttributesBuilder, providing methods to set, remove, and build JSON-based attributes with a fluent API.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns a new empty instance of AttributesBuilder.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new AttributesBuilder initialized with values from a given JsonObject.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair with various data types, optionally filtered by a predicate.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key or a field definition from the builder.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple fields from an iterable of JsonField objects, filtered by a predicate.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an ImmutableAttributes object from the current state.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on jsonObjectBuilder.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
